text: {"lessons":["I sold Stocks A, E, D, and C while they were above my average costs; a gain versus my purchase price alone is not a reason to sell.","I should assess each holding by its future prospects, risks, and role in my overall portfolio—not treat it as a separate account or hold it just to avoid admitting a mistake.","My account value moved up and down over these periods, and past price changes do not predict future ones; I should follow a consistent plan rather than trade on short-term noise."]}
